name: touchdesigner-mcp
description: Drive a running TouchDesigner instance from Claude: create operators, wire them, set parameters, run Python.
long_description: Bridges Claude to TouchDesigner via a Web Server DAT inside your .toe. Every tool call turns into a main-thread exec/eval in TD. Requires the mcp_webserver Web Server DAT (port 9980 by default) set up inside your project — see the project README for the TD-side component.

td_host.title: TouchDesigner host
td_host.description: Host the Web Server DAT is bound to. Leave as 127.0.0.1 for local TD.

td_port.title: TouchDesigner port
td_port.description: Port of the Web Server DAT inside TouchDesigner.

td_path.title: HTTP path
td_path.description: HTTP path the Web Server DAT answers on.

td_instances.title: Multi-instance map (optional)
td_instances.description: Comma-separated name=host:port[/path] entries to target several TD processes at once, e.g. main=127.0.0.1:9980,fx=127.0.0.1:9981. Overrides the single-instance host/port fields when set.

td_default_instance.title: Default instance name
td_default_instance.description: Which entry from the multi-instance map unqualified tool calls target. Ignored if the map is empty.

td_timeout.title: HTTP timeout (seconds)
td_timeout.description: How long to wait for TD to respond before giving up.
